evidence: XPS spectra were excited by nonmonochromatized Mg Ka radiation and measured using 89-eV analyzer energy and 0.5 eV channel width. The films were profiled for hydrogen by nuclear reaction analysis (NRA) technique using a 15N2+ beam... Crystal structure determination was carried out with a Philips MPD 1880 powder X-ray diffractometer using Cu Ka radiation. Film morphology was characterized with a NanoScope III atomic force microscope (AFM). The atomic densities obtained by RBS were converted to geometrical thicknesses using the density of anatase. The films were analyzed for carbon residues with XPS and depth profiling by argon ion sputtering. Hydrogen profiles obtained from NRA measurements were similar to those found earlier with Ti(OCH(CH3)2)4 as precursor. The XRD patterns were observed for films grown at different temperatures. The growth rates were evaluated from transmittance spectra.
